svg.aria-label: Install claude-obsidian in two commands: add the marketplace and install the plugin. A delivery pod lands with a cartridge, the inventory fills with 15 skills, 3 agents march in, /claude-obsidian:wiki previews the vault before writing anything, then the crystal rises and the vault reaches level 1.
